Ed25519 signing tile with key switch, request authorization, and metrics reporting.

# Purpose
`fd_sign_tile.c` implements the `sign` tile in the Firedancer topology. It is a C source file for a runtime tile, not a public library header. The tile receives signing requests from several input links, checks that each request matches the expected role and message size, authorizes the payload with `fd_keyguard_payload_authorize`, and writes a 64-byte Ed25519 signature to the matching output link. It supports several sign formats, including direct Ed25519 signing, SHA-256 prehash signing, and concatenated message forms used for pubkey, metrics, and other request types.

The file also manages sensitive key material and tile setup. It loads the identity key pair, verifies that the public key matches the private key, and updates key state through `fd_keyswitch` during housekeeping. It sets up per-link input and output context, configures seccomp and file descriptor access, records signing latency in `fd_histf_t`, and integrates with the `fd_stem` event loop through [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>), [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>), and housekeeping callbacks.
